meta.name: alterlab-pyopenms
meta.description: Build complete mass-spectrometry workflows with pyOpenMS — feature detection, peptide identification, protein quantification, and full LC-MS/MS pipelines across many MS file formats (mzML, mzXML) and algorithms. Use for comprehensive proteomics and MS data processing — for simple spectral comparison and metabolite identification use matchms. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 用 pyOpenMS 构建完整的质谱分析流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行蛋白质组学或质谱数据的深度分析
copy.tagline_en: Build complete mass-spectrometry workflows with pyOpenMS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process proteomics or mass spectrometry data

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 pyOpenMS 处理质谱数据，包括读取 mzML 等格式、检测特征峰、鉴定肽段和蛋白质、定量分析，以及构建完整的 LC-MS/MS 工作流。
howto.when: 当你要求处理质谱数据（如蛋白质组学或代谢组学分析），或提到 mzML、mzXML 等文件格式时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 mzML 文件，并显示第一个质谱图的信息。
用 FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked 检测特征峰。
对鉴定结果进行 1% FDR 过滤。
say.note: Claude 会计算 q 值并过滤掉假阳性结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process mass spectrometry data using pyOpenMS: read mzML/mzXML files, detect features, identify peptides and proteins, perform quantification, and build complete LC-MS/MS workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process mass spectrometry data (e.g., proteomics or metabolomics analysis) or mention file formats like mzML or mzXML.

say_en.text: Read this mzML file and show info of the first spectrum.

say_en.note: Claude runs the algorithm and returns a FeatureMap.
Claude computes q-values and removes false positives.
